role: CI gate: both the Emuqu and EmuquWatch Watch App targets ship Localizable.xcstrings in Resources, and every localized literal in code resolves to a catalogue key.
toplevel: cd to repo root. SCAN_DIRS Emuqu/Sources and watch app (missing -> 2); catalogue missing -> 2. Python 1 (pbxproj): for each target finds its Resources phase and requires 'Localizable.xcstrings in Resources' (target missing -> 2, missing resource -> 1). Python 2: parse catalogue (error -> 2, empty -> 2); CALL = String(localized:, AttributedString(localized:, LocalizedStringKey(, SwiftUI Text/Button/Label/Toggle/TextField/Picker/Section and modifiers; skips verbatim:; first-argument literals; literals without 2+ letters skipped; each literal's candidate keys must exist or match with %@ widened to a permissive specifier regex; unresolved -> exit 1.

flags.text: scan_literal has no triple-quote handling: `String(localized: """...""")` reads as an empty literal, which the 2-letter filter drops, so multi-line localized literals are never checked. NSLocalizedString( literals are also not in CALL. The orphan gate's copy handles both.
